title: SKE Crystal 2400 4in1 Lemon & Lime Pre-Filled Vape Pods 20mg - 4 x Pods
description: These prefilled SKE Crystal 4in1 pods are brimming with the zesty and zingy flavours of citrusy lemon and lime! Experience a vibrant burst of citrus sunshine, enhanced by the silky-smooth MTL (mouth-to-lung) sensation of Nic-Salt vape juice. The SKE Crystal 4in1 Vape Pods offer some of the most popular flavours from as SKE Crystal Disposable Vapes, yet in a more affordable and sustainable form. Designed for use in the SKE Crystal 4in1 Prefilled Pod Kits, these simple-to-use vape pods can be slotted into the reusable pod kit's revolving mechanism, allowing for four pods in one device.
